COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Avoiding all community work

2. Which statement about Advocacy in the School Community is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Advocacy in the School Community.
   B. Explain Advocacy in the School Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Advocacy in the School Community as rumours only.
   D. Say Advocacy in the School Community never happens in Kenya.

3. Which statement about Building Consensus is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Building Consensus with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Building Consensus.
   C. Treat Building Consensus as rumours only.
   D. Say Building Consensus never happens in Kenya.

4. Which statement about Nurturing Empathy is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Nurturing Empathy never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Nurturing Empathy.
   C. Treat Nurturing Empathy as rumours only.
   D. Explain Nurturing Empathy with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Name the president
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

6. Which statement about Negotiation Skills is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Negotiation Skills as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Negotiation Skills.
   C. Explain Negotiation Skills with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Negotiation Skills never happens in Kenya.

7. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Nakuru
   C. Mombasa
   D. Kisumu

8. Which statement about Intercultural Competence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Intercultural Competence.
   B. Explain Intercultural Competence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Intercultural Competence never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Intercultural Competence as rumours only.

9. Which statement about Building Consensus 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Identification Process 3.2 Im is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Building Consensus 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Identification Process 3.2 Im with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Building Consensus 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Identification Process 3.2 Im never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Building Consensus 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Identification Process 3.2 Im as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Building Consensus 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Identification Process 3.2 Im.

10. Which statement about Nurturing Empathy 2.2 Negotiation Skills 2.3 Building Consensus 3.0 Action Resea is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Nurturing Empathy 2.2 Negotiation Skills 2.3 Building Consensus 3.0 Action Resea never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Nurturing Empathy 2.2 Negotiation Skills 2.3 Building Consensus 3.0 Action Resea as rumours only.
   C. Explain Nurturing Empathy 2.2 Negotiation Skills 2.3 Building Consensus 3.0 Action Resea with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Nurturing Empathy 2.2 Negotiation Skills 2.3 Building Consensus 3.0 Action Resea.

11. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Hide all money underground

12. Which statement about Civic Dialogue is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Civic Dialogue.
   B. Treat Civic Dialogue as rumours only.
   C. Say Civic Dialogue never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Civic Dialogue with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Social Enterprise Management and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Civic Dialogue 1.2 Advocacy in the Community 1.3 Leadership Development 1.4 Inte and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Civic Dialogue and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Advocacy in the School Community and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — Obeying laws and caring for public property

2. B — Explain Advocacy in the School Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. A — Explain Building Consensus with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. D — Explain Nurturing Empathy with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. D — Explain symbols used on a map

6. C — Explain Negotiation Skills with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. A — Nairobi

8. B — Explain Intercultural Competence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. A — Explain Building Consensus 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Identification Process 3.2 Im with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. C — Explain Nurturing Empathy 2.2 Negotiation Skills 2.3 Building Consensus 3.0 Action Resea with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. C — Plan income and spending wisely

12. D — Explain Civic Dialogue with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Social Enterprise Management; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Civic Dialogue 1.2 Advocacy in the Community 1.3 Leadership Development 1.4 Inte; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Civic Dialogue; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Advocacy in the School Community; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
